ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a square with side length 24, and inside it are placed 5 congruent gray rectangles, arranged in a staircase shape: one horizontal rectangle in the lower left corner, with a vertical rectangle connected above it; one horizontal rectangle in the middle; then connected further to the upper right is a vertical rectangle; one horizontal rectangle in the upper right corner. All rectangles are the same size, only their directions may be rotated. Then reason: Let the long side of each congruent rectangle be L, and the short side be W. According to the staircase alignment relationship in the figure, in the horizontal direction, the offset from the left side of the square to the left side of the middle horizontal rectangle is L - W; then after passing through the length L of the middle horizontal rectangle, the width W of the adjacent vertical rectangle, and the length L of the upper-right horizontal rectangle, it reaches the right side of the square. That is, (L - W) + L + W + L = 24, so 3L = 24, getting L = 8. In the vertical direction, according to the up-down alignment relationship in the figure, the height of the square is composed of two long sides and two short sides, that is, 2L + 2W = 24. Substitute L = 8, getting 16 + 2W = 24, so W = 4. Therefore the area of one rectangle is L × W = 8 × 4 = 32 square centimeters.

method.method_draft: Let each congruent rectangle have long side L and short side W. From the diagram, read the stair-step placement: the bottom rectangle is horizontal, the next is vertical, the middle one is horizontal, the next is vertical, and the top-right one is horizontal. Use edge alignments in the square. Horizontally, the left edge of the middle horizontal rectangle is offset by L-W from the square's left side, then moving right across the middle horizontal length L, the adjacent vertical rectangle width W, and the top horizontal rectangle length L reaches the right side; equivalently this simplifies to 3L = 24, so L = 8. Vertically, from the bottom of the top horizontal rectangle down through its aligned vertical rectangle and the middle/bottom levels gives 2L + 2W = 24, so 16 + 2W = 24 and W = 4. Therefore one rectangle has area LW = 8 × 4 = 32 cm^2.
